i had a trade on this pair. at the moment preparing screenshots. trade was inspired by H style:thumbsup:

I was watching this area closely, but didn't get the right PA.

The green line represents what I was hoping to get...a FO to the SR. Long @ the RT to that FO.

Notice the placement of that would-be FO...right to the SR of a swap zone.

Another one...this one was fully formed and there was a nice reaction.

This one dropped way deeper in to the FL than the SR level, but it still worked.

This is such a SIMPLE strategy, yet it is so hard to find them. It is very easy to miss them...

It takes thousands of hours of practice to look through all of the PA & all of the TF's and find the best setups. I miss them all the time..so easy to overlook.
